appStore.name: Shuuty
appStore.subtitle: Voice tasks & delegation
appStore.promotionalText: Say it. Delegate it. Get it done. Record a task naturally, choose a person or group, and keep its due time, reminder, location, and progress together.
appStore.description:
Say it. Delegate it. Get it done.

Shuuty turns everyday decisions into clear next steps - without moving context between notes, chat apps, and calendars.

SAY WHAT NEEDS DOING
Record a task in your own words. Shuuty prepares the title and description, recognizes the due time, reminder, assignee, and place, and can split several thoughts into separate tasks for review.

CHOOSE THE CONTEXT AND DELEGATE
Decide whether the task is private, assigned to a friend, or connected to a group. When you delegate it, the assignee receives it right away, while you can track tasks awaiting acceptance, in progress, and completed.

KEEP THE FULL CONTEXT
Private, Received, and Delegated tasks have clear, separate views. Add subtasks, priorities, due times, reminders, and locations. The conversation and activity stay with the task.

ONE GROUP, MANY ROLES
Use a group as a team workspace, community, client collaboration hub, service offer, or product showcase. Add a detailed description, gallery, public location, and interests. Enable only the modules it needs: chat, threads, tasks, calendar, bookings, plans, projects, and time tracking. Group settings keep its modules and ways of working under control.

MEETINGS AND DISCOVERY
Set the place, time, and participants for a meeting. Discover nearby meetings, public groups, and local offers on the map.

Start for free. Optional Pro and Teams plans raise limits and unlock additional capabilities.

Terms: https://shuuty.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://shuuty.com/privacy/
appStore.whatsNew: Shuuty is ready for action. Create and delegate voice tasks with a due time, reminder, and location. Use refined Private, Received, and Delegated views plus more flexible groups for teamwork, communities, client coordination, and presenting offers. This version also brings the new black-and-gold icon, clearer meetings, calendars, and notifications, more reliable syncing, and smoother recovery from temporary errors.
